item.text: The current parser assumes every `<Objs>` opening tag includes an attribute, calls `.replace()` only on CRLF escapes, and can fail when a matching `<S>` has no text. I’m replacing that extraction path with ordered block parsing and a UTF-16 escape decoder, while keeping the existing per-block concatenation behavior.
